method: Country-specific piecewise anchor histories using institutional/access/development evidence separately from male elite competition outcomes.
evidence_rules: Ruud, Tsitsipas, Goffin and Anderson outcomes inform competition/tradition only.
Norwegian 2022 club scale is tennis/padel combined and the 2023 inclusion fund is an access intervention, not participation.
Belgian 2026 scale is Flanders-only and tennis/padel combined; it is partial Earth BEL evidence.
South African modern development centres/provincial structure are not backcast and do not erase uneven access.
Secondary South African 1891 history is used only for broad tradition context.
No held-out validation ranking is used to tune authored values.
